description: List vectors. dataset.entities is the accepted head state. expected.taskIds is the unpaged order; expected.pages is the same order split by request.page.size (cursors are opaque and not part of the vectors; keyset pagination must equal slicing). Semantics: fields AND; selected values OR; include flag ORs the unassigned case; empty selection with false flag does not restrict; ranges are inclusive and exclude unassigned unless includeUnassigned; sort puts unassigned last in both directions and breaks ties by ascending task id; priority ascending is Urgent first; type orders by enum number; dates compare lexically; milestone name sorts by simple lower-case then code point; cycle key is the cycle start date; story points compare numerically (0 is assigned). Relationship kinds: PARENT has parent_task_id; SUBTASKS is some task naming it as parent; DEPENDS_ON has a dependency; BLOCKS is some task depending on it; RELATED is stored on either side; DUPLICATE_OF has duplicate_of_task_id.
